explanation: Groups reflect the applicable classification framework, not a claim that each covered region has identical amendments, implementation dates or classifications.

schemes.name: EU CLP Regulation
schemes.subtitle: Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008
schemes.description: Shared CLP framework for the EU, Northern Ireland and EEA countries. Regional incorporation dates and transition provisions may differ.
schemes.notice: EEA incorporation dates and Northern Ireland arrangements must be checked. The aggregate status is marked 'Regional variation' whenever these jurisdictions differ.

schemes.name: GB CLP / GB MCL
schemes.subtitle: Great Britain CLP and Mandatory Classification and Labelling List
schemes.description: Separate Great Britain rules; do not automatically substitute an EU Annex VI entry.
schemes.notice: Applies to England, Scotland and Wales, not Northern Ireland.

schemes.name: Swiss Chemicals Ordinance
schemes.subtitle: Swiss chemicals classification and harmonised entries
schemes.description: Swiss adoption of harmonised classifications with national implementation dates.
schemes.notice: A current EU ATP need not yet be implemented in Switzerland.

schemes.name: Türkiye SEA Regulation
schemes.subtitle: SEA Regulation and Annex 6
schemes.description: National harmonised substance entries under Turkish SEA legislation.
schemes.notice: Check amendments to Annex 6 and the governing Turkish legal text.

schemes.name: Malaysia CLASS / ICOP CHC
schemes.subtitle: CLASS Regulations and ICOP CHC 2019
schemes.description: Malaysia's prescribed chemical classifications and hazard communication framework.
schemes.notice: Listed entries must be checked against the current DOSH publication and its legal scope.

schemes.name: South Korea chemical classification
schemes.subtitle: NICS and applicable workplace / chemical legislation
schemes.description: Classification obligations and official entries for designated chemicals under applicable schemes.
schemes.notice: Status varies with substance designation and governing regulation.

schemes.name: China hazardous chemicals framework
schemes.subtitle: GB standards and hazardous chemicals classification table
schemes.description: Chinese GHS classification standards and published hazardous-chemical classification information.
schemes.notice: The classification information table is not a universal harmonised list for all chemicals.

schemes.name: New Zealand HSNO
schemes.subtitle: Hazardous Substances and New Organisms Act approvals
schemes.description: New Zealand's HSNO approvals and GHS-based hazard classes.
schemes.notice: Individual approvals can impose binding classifications; CCID is not universally binding.

schemes.name: Australia WHS / GHS
schemes.subtitle: Work health and safety rules; HCIS reference database
schemes.description: Australia's workplace classification requirements based on GHS 7.
schemes.notice: HCIS is advisory; a requirement to classify is not the same as a binding substance classification list.

schemes.name: Japan GHS / JIS
schemes.subtitle: JIS Z 7252/7253; NITE reference classifications
schemes.description: Japanese classification standards with edition-specific transitions.
schemes.notice: NITE government classifications are reference information, not automatically binding entries.

schemes.name: Canada WHMIS
schemes.subtitle: Hazardous Products Regulations (HPR)
schemes.description: Canada's workplace GHS implementation, with national building blocks and exclusions.
schemes.notice: Environmental hazard classes are outside WHMIS HPR scope; other laws may apply.

schemes.name: United States OSHA HazCom
schemes.subtitle: 29 CFR 1910.1200 (Hazard Communication Standard)
schemes.description: US workplace hazard classification under OSHA HCS.
schemes.notice: OSHA HazCom excludes environmental GHS classes; EPA or other regulatory schemes may still address environmental hazards.

schemes.name: Brazil NR-26 / ABNT
schemes.subtitle: NR-26 and ABNT NBR 14725
schemes.description: Brazilian GHS workplace classification and hazard communication requirements.
schemes.notice: Check the current version of ABNT NBR 14725 and NR-26.

schemes.name: Mexico NOM-018-STPS
schemes.subtitle: NOM-018-STPS-2015
schemes.description: Mexican workplace hazard communication and GHS classification.
schemes.notice: The standard is not a generally binding substance classification catalogue.

schemes.name: Singapore SS 586 / WSH
schemes.subtitle: Singapore Standards and workplace safety legislation
schemes.description: Singapore GHS implementation under SS 586 and WSH requirements.
schemes.notice: Confirm which SS 586 edition applies and the legislation making requirements enforceable.

schemes.name: South Africa HCA / SANS
schemes.subtitle: Hazardous Chemical Agents Regulations and SANS 10234
schemes.description: South Africa's workplace hazardous chemical classification framework.
schemes.notice: The classification standard does not constitute a comprehensive mandatory national substance list.
